core_obligations: Build the algebra (proof lines 1580-1587): set T^1(A) = T(A), iterate, and let C be the colimit of the T^n(A); this is faithfully flat over each T^n(A) and in particular over A, and it is ind-etale over A.

Spread out a given etale map (proof lines 1587-1592): if C -> B is etale then by the descent lemma there exist n and an etale ring map T^n(A) -> B' with B = C tensor over T^n(A) with B'; if moreover C -> B is faithfully flat then the induced map on spectra is surjective and hence Spec(B') -> Spec(T^n(A)) is surjective, that is T^n(A) -> B' is faithfully flat.

Produce the retraction (proof lines 1592-1596): by the construction of the iteration there is a T^n(A)-algebra map B' -> T^{n+1}(A), which induces a C-algebra map B -> C, and this is the required retraction.
proof_roadmap: Iterate the one step construction and take the colimit, checking faithful flatness and ind-etale-ness.
Descend a given etale map over the colimit to a stage and verify faithful flatness there.
Use the defining property of the iteration to build the retraction.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for any ring A there is a faithfully flat ind-etale A-algebra C such that every faithfully flat etale ring map out of C has a retraction (statement lines 1574-1578). The proof (proof lines 1580-1598) iterates the one step construction, takes the colimit, descends a given etale map to a stage, verifies faithful flatness there and builds the retraction from the defining property of the iteration. H2: a three-step construction with three inputs, written out in full.
